maddeler.e:
نعتقل (form VIII)
# نَعْتَقِلُ (naʕtaqilu) /naʕ.ta.qi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# نُعْتَقَلُ (nuʕtaqalu) /nuʕ.ta.qa.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# نَعْتَقِلَ (naʕtaqila) /naʕ.ta.qi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# نُعْتَقَلَ (nuʕtaqala) /nuʕ.ta.qa.la/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
